in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the guardian of the door to the divine world, the deity of the temple town of Dwarka.

in_hindi.meaning: ध्वार पालक ईश्वर (God of the door)

in_marathi.name: Dwarkanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Dwarka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwarkanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dwarkanath is a Sanskrit name that means 'Lord of Dwarka'. In Hindu mythology, Dwarka is the name of a holy city where Lord Krishna resided. Dwarkanath is believed to be a powerful and revered name, signifying the divine presence and protection of the deity.
